Name: Artisan Workshop
Author: RoyJ549
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b]Artisan Workshop[/b][/size]

[i]One workshop menu for your machines, recipes, materials, and artisan production.[/i]

[b]Current version: v0.3.0[/b]

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[b]中文问题反馈请添加 QQ 群：1127843521[/b]



[size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size]

[b]Artisan Workshop[/b] brings your processing machines, recipes, materials, crafting, and finished products together in one unified interface.

Browse supported machines across locations, check what they can produce, see which materials are available, craft directly through the Workshop, and collect finished products without walking between every machine yourself.

With the optional [b]Remote Crafting[/b], [b]Remote Collection[/b], and [b]Global Storage[/b] features, supported artisan production can be managed across your save from one place.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Unified Workshop Menu[/b]
Browse supported machines, recipes, required materials, current machine state, and craftable quantity from one interface.
[/*]
[*][b]Multi-location Machine Browsing[/b]
Browse supported machines across normal persistent locations in your current save.
[/*]
[*][b]Direct MachineData / EMC Crafting[/b]
Craft through supported vanilla and modded MachineData execution paths, including compatible multi-material recipes.
[/*]
[*][b]Chest Material Support[/b]
Use materials from your inventory and supported Chest / Big Chest storage.
[/*]
[*][b]Optional Remote Crafting[/b]
Operate supported machines in another persistent location without traveling to the machine first.
[/*]
[*][b]Optional Remote Collection[/b]
Collect one supported ready machine, or collect all supported ready machines in the selected location — even while your character is somewhere else.
[/*]
[*][b]Optional Global Storage[/b]
Allow supported chests in other eligible persistent locations to contribute crafting materials.
[/*]
[*][b]Machine Execution Profiles[/b]
Machines sharing the same machine ID but using different execution behavior can be planned and handled separately.
[/*]
[*][b]Mergable Machines 0.2.0 Compatibility[/b]
Verified support for stacked-machine grouping and stack-scaled material requirements.
[/*]
[*][b]Producer Framework Mod Browsing[/b]
Compatible PFM machines and recipes can be discovered and browsed. Direct Workshop execution remains unsupported.
[/*]
[*][b]Lookup Anything Support[/b]
Workshop item hover information integrates with Lookup Anything where applicable.
[/*]
[*][b]English + Simplified Chinese[/b]
Full interface localization is included.[/*]
[/list]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Controls & Configuration[/b][/size]

[b]Default hotkey: F7[/b] — Open or close Artisan Workshop.

The hotkey and Workshop settings can be changed through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] or [b]config.json[/b].

GMCM is optional and is not required to use Artisan Workshop.


[b]Allow Remote Crafting[/b]
[i]Default: Disabled[/i]

Allows supported MachineData / EMC machines in other persistent locations to be operated through the Workshop.


[b]Allow Remote Collection[/b]
[i]Default: Disabled[/i]

Allows finished products from supported ready machines to be collected remotely.


[b]Chest Inventory Scope[/b]
[i]Default: Selected Location Only[/i]

[b]Selected Location Only[/b]
Materials may come from:
[list]
[*]Player inventory[/*]
[*]Supported chests in the currently selected location[/*]
[/list]
[b]All Persistent Locations[/b]
Materials may additionally come from supported chests in other eligible persistent locations.


[b]Remote Crafting, Remote Collection, and Chest Inventory Scope are independent settings.[/b]

For example, you can enable Remote Collection without enabling Remote Crafting, or use Global Storage while crafting machines in your current location.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Remote Collection[/b][/size]

Remote Collection is [b]disabled by default[/b].

When enabled, Artisan Workshop can collect finished products from supported ready machines in the selected location, even when the player is currently somewhere else.


[b]Collect One[/b]
Collects one supported ready machine from the currently selected machine group.


[b]Collect All[/b]
Collects all supported ready machines in the selected location.


Currently verified output support includes:

[list]
[*]Standard [b]StardewValley.Object[/b] outputs[/*]
[*]Verified [b]ColoredObject[/b] outputs, including preserves and similar colored artisan goods[/*]
[/list]
For ColoredObject outputs, relevant item state is preserved through collection, including:

[list]
[*]Color[/*]
[*]Quality[/*]
[*]Preserve type[/*]
[*]Preserved parent[/*]
[*]Stack state[/*]
[*]modData[/*]
[*]Other relevant item metadata[/*]
[/list]
Artisan Workshop deliberately uses a narrow compatibility policy for remote collection.

[b]Bundled, nested, or otherwise unsupported special outputs are skipped safely instead of being partially or ambiguously collected.[/b]

Before collection, the Workshop validates the relevant location, machine identity, machine state, session state, and collection request. Stale or already-consumed requests are rejected rather than being allowed to collect the same output twice.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Remote Crafting[/b][/size]

Remote Crafting is [b]disabled by default[/b].

When enabled, supported MachineData / EMC machines in another normal persistent location can be operated through Artisan Workshop without requiring the player to travel there first.

For example:

[code]
Player location: FarmHouse
Selected Workshop location: Town
Target machine: Town[/code]
The Workshop can operate the supported Town machine while the player remains in FarmHouse.

Remote Crafting only changes where the target machine may be operated.

It does [b]not[/b] automatically enable Global Storage.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Global Storage[/b][/size]

When [b]Chest Inventory Scope[/b] is set to [b]All Persistent Locations[/b], supported chests in other eligible persistent locations can contribute crafting materials.

Material priority remains deterministic:

[list=1]
[*]Player inventory[/*]
[*]Selected location[/*]
[*]Other eligible persistent locations[/*]
[*]Chests by stable tile order[/*]
[*]Slots within each chest[/*]
[/list]
The selected location is preferred before other remote storage locations.

Before execution, Artisan Workshop revalidates material sources and machine state. If something has changed since planning, the operation fails safely instead of silently switching to a different source.

Global Storage currently uses supported [b]Chest / Big Chest[/b] sources.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Execution Safety[/b][/size]

Artisan Workshop is designed to avoid ambiguous or partially completed operations.

[list]
[*]Material allocations are fixed for each execution attempt.[/*]
[*]The Workshop does not silently replace a planned material source during the same operation.[/*]
[*]Target machine and location identity are rechecked before execution.[/*]
[*]Machine state changes can safely invalidate an older request.[/*]
[*]Remote Collection rejects stale and duplicate requests.[/*]
[*]Unsupported output structures are filtered before native collection is attempted.[/*]
[/list]
If the Workshop cannot safely confirm that an operation is still valid, it stops instead of guessing.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Mergable Machines Compatibility[/b][/size]

Artisan Workshop includes compatibility for the verified [b]Mergable Machines 0.2.0[/b] behavior.

For compatible stacked machines:

[list]
[*]Different stack sizes are separated into different execution groups.[/*]
[*]Material requirements scale with the machine stack size.[/*]
[*]Primary and compatible additional materials are planned before execution.[/*]
[*]Craftable quantity reflects the complete stacked-machine requirement.[/*]
[*]Changing the machine stack after planning invalidates the older plan safely.[/*]
[*]Remote Crafting and Global Storage can be used with supported stacked machines.[/*]
[/list]
For example, if one machine normally requires:

[list]
[*]1 primary ingredient[/*]
[*]1 additional ingredient[/*]
[/list]
then a compatible machine with [b]Stack ×5[/b] is planned as requiring:

[list]
[*]5 primary ingredients[/*]
[*]5 additional ingredients[/*]
[/list]
Artisan Workshop does not calculate or duplicate the resulting stacked output itself.

Final stacked output behavior remains handled by Mergable Machines through its own execution patches.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Producer Framework Mod Support[/b][/size]

Artisan Workshop includes browsing support for compatible machines registered through [b]Producer Framework Mod[/b].

Where a PFM rule can be resolved safely, the Workshop can display:

[list]
[*]Available recipes[/*]
[*]Required ingredients and fuel[/*]
[*]Missing materials[/*]
[*]Craftable quantity[/*]
[*]Idle / processing / ready state[/*]
[/list]
[b]PFM recipes remain browse-only in Artisan Workshop.[/b]

Direct Workshop crafting and Remote Collection execution are not currently enabled for PFM-backed machines.

PFM compatibility may vary between content packs depending on how their production rules and custom behavior are implemented.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[b]Artisan Workshop does not require Automate.[/b]

Currently supported or integrated:

[list]
[*]Vanilla MachineData machines[/*]
[*]Compatible modded MachineData machines[/*]
[*]Compatible Extra Machine Config / EMC multi-material rules[/*]
[*]Chest / Big Chest material sources[/*]
[*]Remote Crafting for supported MachineData / EMC execution paths[/*]
[*]Remote Collection for explicitly supported ready-machine outputs[/*]
[*]Global Storage across eligible persistent locations[/*]
[*]Mergable Machines 0.2.0[/*]
[*]Producer Framework Mod machine and recipe browsing[/*]
[*]Lookup Anything item-hover integration[/*]
[/list]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Current Limitations[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]PFM-backed recipes are browse-only.[/b]
[/*]
[*]Remote Collection intentionally skips bundled, nested, and unsupported special output types.
[/*]
[*]Remote Collection currently uses a narrow set of explicitly verified output types rather than accepting arbitrary Object subclasses.
[/*]
[*]Global Storage currently uses supported Chest / Big Chest sources only.
[/*]
[*]Fridges, Junimo Chest networks, and third-party global-storage APIs are not currently included as material sources.
[/*]
[*]Dynamic Mine and Skull Cavern floors are not intended as Global Storage sources.
[/*]
[*]Volcano dungeon areas, festival maps, event maps, and other temporary locations are not guaranteed Remote Crafting, Remote Collection, or Global Storage targets.
[/*]
[*]Modded locations with unstable or unusual lifecycle behavior may be excluded from remote operations.
[/*]
[*]Multiplayer and arbitrary third-party machine hooks are not currently guaranteed to be supported.
[/*]
[*]Mergable Machines compatibility is currently verified against version 0.2.0. Unverified future versions may disable stacked execution safely if compatibility cannot be confirmed.[/*]
[/list]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download Artisan Workshop.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]ArtisanWorkshop[/b] folder into:

[code]
Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code][/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F7[/b] to open Artisan Workshop.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]

GMCM is not required.

If installed, it provides an in-game interface for:

[list]
[*]Changing the Workshop hotkey[/*]
[*]Enabling or disabling Remote Crafting[/*]
[*]Enabling or disabling Remote Collection[/*]
[*]Changing the Chest Inventory Scope[/*]
[/list]
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━


[size=4][b]Troubleshooting & Bug Reports[/b][/size]

If you encounter a compatibility issue, please include as much of the following information as possible:

[list]
[*]Your SMAPI log[/*]
[*]Machine name[/*]
[*]Machine or content-pack mod name[/*]
[*]Relevant recipe or finished output[/*]
[*]Current machine state[/*]
[*]Whether Remote Crafting was enabled[/*]
[*]Whether Remote Collection was enabled[/*]
[*]Your Chest Inventory Scope[/*]
[*]Whether the machine was stacked[/*]
[/list]
This makes compatibility problems much easier to reproduce and diagnose.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
